def scan(core):
    Bc=np.column_stack(core); out=[]
    for w in np.linspace(0.05,8,1600):
        B=np.column_stack([Bc,np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t)])

        out.append((np.sqrt(np.mean((B@c-dv_dt)**2)),w))
    out.sort(); return out[0]

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
